subject: How to get exact name/id of resource

messages.author: 7d0f4f0ed1778184
messages.subject: How to get exact name/id of resource
parts:
Hi Team,

Suppose I have 4 resources of "Pick_M" using below command. Is there a way to print resource name/id (out of four which one it is) in our program?
I wanted to assign different timeout time on the basis of name, so wanted to know which resource id/name it is exactly.

add_resource("Pick_M", 4) %>%

messages.author: 0f5b7adb7e70bd8b
messages.subject: Re: [simmer-devel] How to get exact name/id of resource
parts:
2018-03-12 9:32 GMT+01:00 K7 <krishnam...@gmail.com>:
> Hi Team,
>
> Suppose I have 4 resources of "Pick_M" using below command. Is there a way
> to print resource name/id (out of four which one it is) in our program?
> I wanted to assign different timeout time on the basis of name, so wanted to
> know which resource id/name it is exactly.
>

> add_resource("Pick_M", 4) %>%.

If you add several resources under the same name, they are
indistinguishable. If you want to distinguish them, you have to add
resources with different names: Pick_M_1, Pick_M_2... etc.

Iñaki
